description: Buy one part pack: a component's frozen module outputs (pinout, footprint, limits, timing and the others the manifest lists) as one JSON envelope. Price: 3 module credits with a DatasheetVend API key, charged once per account (the same pack again is free), or $2.00 per call with a Stripe machine payment (no account, so each call pays). The pack is found before anything is charged: a missing pack, an unnamed package when several are shelved, or a pack too large for one answer costs nothing. Read the free manifest first: a pack may cover only some modules. The manufacturer's PDF is linked, never included. This is not the $19 Verified Pack sold on the website.

package.description: Package slug from the manifest (e.g. 'tqfp-32'). Required when more than one package is shelved; null or empty means not given.

vendor_slug.description: Vendor slug as in the component library, e.g. 'microchip'.
